name: Beneficial Owner 1
definition: Provides information about the beneficial owner of the securities.

BeneficialOwnerIdentification.name: Beneficial Owner Identification
BeneficialOwnerIdentification.definition: Identification of the party that is the beneficial owner of the specified securities.

AdditionalIdentification.name: Additional Identification
AdditionalIdentification.definition: Additional identification of the party that is the beneficial owner of the specified securities.

DomicileCountry.name: Domicile Country
DomicileCountry.definition: Country in which a person is permanently domiciled (the place of a persons permanent home).

NonDomicileCountry.name: Non Domicile Country
NonDomicileCountry.definition: The holder of the security has to certify, in line with the terms of the corporate action, that it is not domiciled in the country indicated.

CertificationIndicator.name: Certification Indicator
CertificationIndicator.definition: Whether or not certification is required from the account owner. |Yes: certification required |No: no certification required.

CertificationType.name: Certification Type
CertificationType.definition: Type of certification which is required.

DeclarationDetails.name: Declaration Details
DeclarationDetails.definition: Provides declaration details narrative relative to the financial instrument, eg, beneficial ownership.

ElectedSecuritiesQuantity.name: Elected Securities Quantity
ElectedSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Quantity of securities elected by to the beneficial owner.
